programme.title: Scottish Women's Premier League (BBC ALBA)
programme.desc: An dearbaidh Dhùn Èideann eadar Hearts agus Hibernian à Tynecastle beò air BBC ALBA. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le aithris bho Donna NicNeill. The Edinburgh derby at Tynecastle as Hearts take on Hibernian live on BBC ALBA. Full match coverage with commentary from Donna MacNeill.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e? The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon 's a phàrantan ag ullachadh 'son turas air falbh, feumaidh Pompon tighinn gu co-dhùnadh air dè tha riatanach a thoirt leis sa bhaga aige. When Pompon and his parents prepare to go on a trip, Pompon must come to a decision as to what is essential for him to take in his bag.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha cuid dhe na rudan as fheàrr le Àtaidh agus Tilidh a dhìth. A bheil cuideigin air an goid? ’S e rùn-dìomhair a th’ ann! Some of Abney and Teal’s favourite objects are missing. Has there been a robbery? It’s a mystery!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach airson ’s gum bi co-là-breith sònraichte aig Maigheach. Tha cuireadh aig Comhachag is Tosg, fhad ’s a bheir iad prèasant brèagha thuice, leithid dìthean le fàileadh cùbhraidh. Chan eil sin cho furasta ’s a shaoileas iad. Fhad ’s a tha iad trang a’ lorg nam prèasantan tha Maigheach air bhioran ’s I a’ feitheamh gus an tòisich am pàrtaidh co-là-breith aice. Fox wants to give Hare the best birthday ever. Owl and Tusk are invited, but only if they bring a nice present, like a beautifully scented flower. But that is not quite as easy as it seems. All the while Hare is kept waiting for her birthday party to start.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: SPFL
programme.desc: Ball-coise bho Lìog a h-Aon le Hamilton Academical a’ cur fàilte air Ross County, beò air BBC ALBA. An geama beò ri fhaicinn le preasantair Alasdair MacIllinnein agus aithris bho Ailig O’Henley. Join BBC Alba for live League 1 football action as Hamilton Academical host Ross County. Full coverage with presenter Alasdair MacLennan and commentary from Alex O’Henley.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke: a foraged feast with musical friends in Galloway. Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke le stòras nàdair. Ròic na Rùrachd le càirdean ciùil an Gall Ghàidhealaibh.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Shetland’s expansive coastline is home to endless towering cliffs, but its remoteness from the mainland means they see few ascents. With a friend in tow, Coinneach Rankin travels to Shetland in search of new routes and spectacular climbing challenges. Tha oirthir fhada Shealtainn loma làn chreagan tomadach agus seallaidhean nach creidear, ach air sgàth cho cèin ’s a tha i bho thir-mòr, chan fhaigh cus an cothrom sreap ann. Le seann charaid na chuideachd, siubhailidh Coinneach MacFhraing a Shealtainn air tòir slighean ùra is dùbhlain bharraichte. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Kim Carnie on the island of Kerrera, where they walk along picturesque bays with panoramic views of Oban Bay and the Slate Islands. Kim discusses the importance of Gaelic in her life and how that has shaped her career as a singer. She opens up about love and identity, and how that has evolved over the years, whilst enjoying the surrounding nature and fresh autumn air. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Kim Carnie air eilean Chearrara far a bheil iad air an cuartachadh le bàghean àlainn agus seallaidhean air leth den Òban agus na h-Eileanan Sglèata. Innsidh Kim cho cudromach ‘s a tha Gàidhlig na beatha ‘s a bhuaidh a tha seo air a thoirt air a beatha agus air a dreuchd na seinneadair. Gu follaiseach dèidheil air àm an fhoghair agus an àrainneachd ghlan mun cuairt, tha i fuasgladh suas ma beachdan air gaol, fèin-aithne agus mar a tha sin air obrachadh a-mach na beatha fhèin. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Obair sgioba an Aonad Dlùth-chùram Leanabain ’s iad a’ coimhead an dèidh naoidheanan so-leònta. The work of the NICU team and their care for vulnerable babies.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Thàinig an ola gu Fraochy Bay ach de a' bhuaidh a tha e air a thoirt air a' bhaile agus na daoine? Agus de cho fada sa sheasas e, agus de ni muinntir a' bhaile leis an dìleab? Fraochy Bay has experienced an oil boom, but just as quickly as it arrived it dries up, causing a swift departure of the oil industry. How will the townsfolk deal with the leftovers?

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Steelmen
programme.desc: Ann an 1991, bha baile Thobar na Màthar a’ greimeachadh ris a’ bhuaidh shòisealta, eaconamach agus chultarail a bheireadh dùnadh ionad stàilinn Ravenscraig air an sgìre, ach airson a’ chiad uair ann an 39 bliadhna thog sgioba ball-coise a’ bhaile, na ‘Steelmen' mar a theirear riutha, Cupa na h-Alba, a’ toirt boillsgeadh dòchais a thogadh an dorchadas. In 1991, as the town of Motherwell faced the crippling social, economic and cultural impact of the closure of the Ravenscraig steelworks, its football club, locally known as the Steelmen, lifted the prestigious Scottish Cup for the first time in 39 years. The victory was a glimmer of light in the ensuing darkness.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Fiona NicChoinnich agus Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilte air luchd-amhairc chun a’ chuid às fheàrr de Fhèis Belladrum 2022. Anns a' phrògram seo, cothrom am prìomh thaisbeanadh air Àrd-ùrlar a Ghàrraidh bho oidhche Dhiardaoin na Fèise fhaicinn. Bha an t-àite loma-làn airson an taisbeanadh aig an t-seinneadair chliùiteach Emile Sandé, a tha air soirbheachadh mu mòr mar sgrìobhaiche òran agus air na milleanan de chlàran album a reic air feadh an t-saoghail. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain MacDonald host highlights from the Belladrum festival, 2022. This programme features the headlining act from the Garden Stage on Thursday night at the festival. Performing in front of a packed audience was acclaimed singer Emeli Sandé, one of Britain’s most successful songwriters, having sold millions of albums worldwide.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Last of the Hunters ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Last of the Hunters in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le cuideachadh bho Burtaidh, tha Sif a’ toirt Pipp agus Bran air dàn-chuairt fèill spòrs. Ziff leads Pipp and Button on a fairground adventure with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Bèibidh Dràgon Brot’ mì-thoilichte oir chan fhaod e cluich leis an spàin bhrot’ oir tha ro mhòr dha. Gu fortanach, tha Beag a’ moladh gum faod e taic a thoirt dhaibh-san le bhith toirt am brot air ais dhan uamh – is abair g’eil e taiceil! Baby Soup Dragon is unhappy - he isn’t allowed to play with the soup spoon as it’s too big for him. Fortunately, Small suggests that he can help to deliver the soup instead - and he is hugely helpful!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha bogsa dìomhaireachd air laighe air a’ phlanaid, le rudan annasach na bhroinn - clobhdan a tha nan tuill cuideachd. Tha e comasach dha na Clangairean siubhal tro na tuill seo - agus abair gu bheil iad trang a’ siubhal! A mysterious box has landed on the planet, with curious things inside it - cloths which are also holes. The Clangers can travel through these holes, and they do it a lot!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha a’ ghrian a’ deàrrsadh ‘s tha Ooona'son dhol a dh’iasgach. Tha May ag aontachadh cluich cuide ri Baba ach tha Baba a’ diùltadh faiche nan gràineag fhàgail gus an dùisg Spiky bho chadal-geamhraidh! It’s a beautiful day and Oona wants to practise fishing. May offers to play with Baba, who refuses to leave the hedghog burrow as he wants to wait until Spiky wakes from his hibernation!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona daonnan ann an cabhag ach tha Papa airson sealltainn dhi gum bi buthaidean a' gabhail cùisean air an socair. Saoil an tig aice air ionnsachadh rudan a dhèanamh ann an ‘Dòigh na Buthaide? Oona is forever in a hurry to learn and get things done, but Papa wants to show her that puffins tend to approach things in a slow and steady fashion. Will Oona master the ‘Way of the Puffin?’

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Sula a’ tadhal air Bing ‘s i air a h-aodann a pheantadh mar dhealan-dè, tha i airson aodann Bing a’ pheantadh cuideachd. Chaneil am peantadh a' dol ro mhath ach tha e sealbhach gu bheil Flop ri làimh airson gnothaichean a rèiteachadh. When Sula visits Bing with her face painted like a butterfly, she also wants to face paint Bing. But the painting doesn’t go well for them. Fortunately, Flop is on hand to sort it all out.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing brònach nuair a thèid innse dha, an-dèidh dha a’ bhanachdach fhaighinn, nach eil gin de na steigearan sònraichte as fheàrr leis air fhàgail. Tha cùisean ag atharrachadh ge-tà nuair a tha e a’ faighinn teisteanas grinn, sònraichte. Bing is sad when he is told, after having had his vaccination, that there are none of his favourite stickers left at Dr Molly’s surgery. He soon cheers up though when he is given a very special certificate instead.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha tòrr spòrs aig Peicein is a charaidean a’ cur an ìre gur e ròbotan a th’ annta, gus am brùth cuideigin aca putan is tha an aileag a’ tòiseachadh air Peicein. Carson nach stad an aileag aige? Bheil smachd aig cuideigin air à àiteigin eile? Chan urrainn do Ghriogair sguir a shreothartaich, Lòra a mhèaranaich neo Raghnall a chasadaich. Saoil a bheil iad uile a’ tionndadh nan ròbotan dhà-rìribh? Petit and his friends are having a lot of fun pretending to be robots, until one of them presses a button and Petit gets the hiccups. Why can't he stop hiccupping? Is someone else controlling him from somewhere? Greg can't stop sneezing, Laura yawns and Roman coughs. Could it be that everyone is turning into real life robots?

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ tionndadh gu leabhar dìomhair airson ionnsachadh mar a chuidicheas i beathannan Dhaibhidh agus a màthair – ach, mo chreach, abair gu ‘eil a coibhneis cosgail is croiseil dhaibh uile. Hilda turns to a mysterious book to learn how she can better the lives of Daibhidh and her mother, but being kind proves to be costly and problematic for all.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Nuair tha Greta an cù a’ cèilidh air an sgoil, tha Flix airson a bhith taiceil dhi. Gu mì-fhortanach tha iad glè mhì-mhodhail nuair a tha ‘ad còmhla. Tha seo ag adhbharachadh trioblaid coin-cait ach the feum air fuasgladh cait-coin. When Greta the dog visits the school, Flix wants to be helpful to her. Unfortunately, they’re very badly behaved when together. This causes a dog-cat problem so what’s needed is a cat-dog solution!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha cùisean a-dol ceàrr leis na Farpaisich ach tha a’ Chrùbag faisg air làimh le cobhair, tòrr ruitheam agus an 'cha cha cha'! Things go awry with the competitors, but Crùbag is near to hand, with lots of rhythm and the 'cha cha cha'!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Isra cho toilichte nuair a tha i a’ faighinn an cothrom càmpadh mar a sìnnsearan - na Bedouin - còmhla ri a caraid, Laoise. Isra is delighted when she gets the chance to go camping like her ancestors, the Bedouin, with her friend, Laoise.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Ann am prògram às an tasglann bho 2009, Salm 31 air a sheinn le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghlaschu, Laoidh Chalum Chille le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn agus bidh Torcuil MacLeòid ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na bheatha fhèin. Air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. In an archival edition from 2009, Psalm 31 sung by the Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet, the hymn Laoidh Chalum Chille by Govan Gaelic Choir, and Torquil MacLeod tells his personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor makes his grannie’s gingerbread and classic Scottish tablet, and adds his own flair to her fishcake recipe.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Surfing: Marcachd an Tuinn/Riding the Wave
programme.desc: Tha Ceitlin Lilidh a’ toirt thugainn sreath de dhà phàirt air eachdraidh surfadh air feadh an t-saoghail. Ceitlin Lilidh's series on the world history of surfing.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: We explore the surprising ways animals use touch to sense their world, find food and stay out of danger.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.desc: Jonathan Foyle explores some of the best Georgian and Victorian neoclassical civic buildings, visiting town halls, concert halls, libraries, schools and galleries in Liverpool, Leeds, Bradford, Manchester and Todmorden in an unlikely story of rivalry, ambition and power in the service of social responsibility. Featuring contributions from historians.

programme.title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure
programme.desc: Historian Dr Janina Ramirez unlocks the secrets of a centuries-old masterpiece in glass, the East Window at York Minster - the largest medieval stained-glass window in the country and the creative vision of a master craftsman called John Thornton. Within its 311 panels is the entire history of the world.

programme.title: The Medici: Makers of Modern Art
programme.desc: Andrew Graham-Dixon reveals how the Medici family transformed Florence through sculpture, painting and architecture. Graham-Dixon examines how the family of businessmen became the engine behind the Italian Renaissance.

programme.title: This Is BBC Four
programme.desc: BBC FOUR is the BBC channel for people who want more. More depth, more range, more to stimulate the mind.

programme.title: Girls in Bands at the BBC
programme.desc: Compilation celebrating some guitar band performances at the BBC that feature some of the best female musicians in rock. Beginning with the oft-forgotten American group Fanny performing You're the One, it's a journey along rock's spectrum from the 1970s to now. The selection includes the powerful vocals of Elkie Brooks on Vinegar Joe's Proud to Be a Honky Woman, the mesmerising poetry of Patti Smith's Horses and the upbeat energy of The Go-Go's on We Got the Beat. Mighty basslines come courtesy of Tina Weymouth on Psycho Killer and Kim Gordon on Sugar Kane, whilst we trace the line of indie rock from the Au Pairs through Lush, Elastica and Garbage to current band Savages.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Bruno Brookes and Sybil Ruscoe present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 10 November 1988 and featuring Brother Beyond, Bryan Ferry, Robin Beck, Salt-N-Pepa, INXS, Chris de Burgh, Deacon Blue, Enya and Prince.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: David Jensen presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 11 November 1982. Featuring Blue Zoo, A Flock of Seagulls, Clannad, Dionne Warwick, Donna Summer, Marvin Gaye, Eddy Grant and Zoo.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Tony Blackburn presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 23 September 1976 and featuring Smokie, Kiki Dee, The Drifters, Manfred Mann's Earth Band, The Wurzels, Bay City Rollers, Rod Stewart, ABBA, and dance sequences from Ruby Flipper.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Richard Blackwood presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 4 August 2000 and featuring Macy Gray, Bomfunk MCs, Santana, Samantha Mumba, Point Break, Moloko, Janet Jackson and Craig David.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Jayne Middlemiss presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 11 August 2000 and featuring Craig David, Reef, Wookie & Lain, Mansun, Storm, MJ Cole, Ronan Keating and Robbie Williams.

programme.title: Wild
programme.desc: Documentary presenting an intimate portrait of one of Britain's most charming wild animals, following a family of water voles living on a canal in Derbyshire though a typical year. The picturesque Cromford canal used to serve the region's cotton mills. Now, having been deserted, it serves as a perfect water vole paradise. For these hyperactive little mammals, a year is nearly a lifetime. They spend their lives in a frenzy of activity - swimming, feeding and breeding - the latter of most necessity, since water voles are becoming a rarity.

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Michael Palin circles the Pacific Rim through 18 countries. After a journey on a rusty ferry through the dangerous Sulu Sea, he arrives in Borneo at monsoon time. From the rainforest, he heads off to the long houses of the Iban tribesmen and the secret heart of Borneo. Across the equator in Java, the most densely populated island in the world, he visits the largest monument in the southern hemisphere.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: In the late 1940s, Gerry Burton, accompanied by his sister Joanna, goes to the little village of Lymston to convalesce after an accident. The village seems to welcome them with open arms. But there are dark mysterious undercurrents at work and it's not long before Miss Marple comes to visit.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Treasures
programme.desc: Dan is captivated by the sword of a Samurai warrior and the artistry employed to make this beautiful instrument of death. By contrast, he finds solace and tranquillity in a Japanese temple and meditation garden.

programme.title: Ran
programme.desc: Akira Kurosawa's epic masterpiece is a reworking of Shakespeare's King Lear set in medieval Japan. After a lifetime of battles, 70-year-old Lord Hidetora announces that he is passing his authority to his eldest son Taro. The youngest son Saburo protests and is banished from the kingdom. But instead of fulfilling their father's wishes, Taro and middle brother Jiro are disloyal to the former lord and attack his castle. Hidetora survives but following his sons' betrayal is now losing his mind. When Jiro has his brother murdered, the banished Saburo and his allies return to fight a battle against the remaining brother. In Japanese with English subtitles.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Sam Shepard narrates a documentary profile of celebrated Japanese film-maker Akira Kurosawa, responsible for the films Seven Samurai, Ikiru and Rashomon.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Stately sitcom. A repair bill for Audrey's Rolls-Royce finally convinces her to revert to four-legged horsepower.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Sitcom. When Hyacinth hears that Emmet is rehearsing a musical, she is beside herself. Unfortunately sorting out Daddy's antics has to take priority.

programme.title: The Medici: Makers of Modern Art
programme.desc: Documentary in which Andrew Graham-Dixon reveals how the Medici family transformed Florence through sculpture, painting and architecture, and created a world where masterpieces fetch millions today. Without the money and patronage of the Medici we might never have heard of artists such as Donatello, Michelangelo or Botticelli. Graham-Dixon examines how a family of shadowy, corrupt businessmen, driven by greed and ambition, became the financial engine behind the Italian Renaissance.

We meet the team developing an autonomous underwater robot to measure ice thickness from beneath the surface. And Alasdair Keane is in San Francisco to find out why thousands of solar-powered buoys are being deployed around the world.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: Clive travels inland from the hustle and bustle of Lagos to Abeokuta. He gets his shorts on to test his basketball skills on the court with an inspirational coach, before getting suited and booted to attend the birthday celebrations of a local gospel singer and see just how Nigerians throw a party. He also gets hands-on to create authentic tie-and-dye adire clothes and joins in with an incredible contemporary dance troupe.

programme.title: The Big Cases
programme.desc: In one of the biggest UK celebrity trials, Russell Brand is jailed after being found guilty of rape and sexual assaults. This is the story of how the actor, once one of the biggest faces on TV, ended up disgraced. This film hears from the police, a former friend and an investigative journalist behind the original expose on Brand. The BBC’s Helena Wilkinson who attended the trial reports. If you or someone you know has been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, information and support is available at BBC Action Line.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: It's been a week of great consequence for the media. On Monday, Russell Brand was sentenced to over ten years in prison for rape and sexual assault. On Tuesday - in a separate story - ITV News and The Guardian named David Walliams as the celebrity who tried to use an injunction to block the publication of sexual misconduct allegations. Our panel discusses the issues raised: Rosamund Urwin, chief news correspondent at The Sunday Times; Alex Wilson, partner at RPC, and Sarah Ditum, author of Toxic: Women, Fame and The Noughties.

programme.title: BBC News

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: South London zoologist and urban wildlife enthusiast, Lira Valencia, heads to Brazil to discover how humans and animals coexist in the most biodiverse country on earth. Lira begins her journey in the megacity of São Paulo, where she meets the people keeping the city's spectacular fauna safe from the expanding urban environment. She comes face to face with the cuddly, but powerful capybaras in São Paulo's public parks, and meets the puma family who've become stars in the local community.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: The AI industry has just had the fright of its life. After a shock US midterm election result handed Democrats control of both houses of Congress, the companies leading the AI revolution suddenly face an uncomfortable reality: investigations, subpoenas, public backlash and the prospect of sweeping new regulation. At the very centre of the storm is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company sits at the heart of the global AI boom. Recent revelations surrounding Huang have triggered a crisis of confidence, wiped hundreds of billions from Nvidia's market value, and raised difficult questions about corporate governance, national security and the concentration of power inside the AI industry. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's political gamble appears to have backfired spectacularly. After pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms, Silicon Valley's most influential figures are now confronting a Congress that may be far less willing to give them the benefit of the doubt.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Akisa Wandera reports from Angola, where billions of dollars are being poured into a vast new trade corridor at the centre of a global race for critical minerals. We examine what's at stake for the people living on the frontline of this transformation. Plus: BBC Brasil travels to the city of Camaçari, where Chinese carmaker BYD has opened its biggest factory in Latin America. She comes face to face with the cuddly, but powerful capybaras in São Paulo's public parks, and meets the puma family who've become stars in the local community.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: La historia de Johnny Cash, quien forma una unión estable con June Carter y lucha contra su adicción a las drogas camino al estrellato.

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Armado únicamente con muchos sueños y ganas de aventura, el joven chocolatero Willy Wonka conoce a los Oompa Loompas y se dispone a cambiar el mundo.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Un grupo de inversores, personas corrientes, se enriquece revalorizando artificialmente la empresa GameStop, que estaba en franco declive. El motor de todo esto es Keith Gill, un tipo normal que pone todos sus ahorros en la compañía.

programme.title: Won't Back Down
programme.desc: Dos mujeres se enfrentan contra una poderosa burocracia y un sistema sumido en el pensamiento tradicional para transformar la escuela de sus hijos.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes del siglo XX que pertenecen a familias rivales se enamoran y viven un trágico romance que tiene como destino la muerte.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Confinado a un pulmón de acero, el escritor Mark O'Brien consulta a una terapeuta sexual para perder su virginidad.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: El príncipe heredero al trono de Austria aparece muerto y las pruebas apuntan a un suicidio. Sin embargo, Sherlock Holmes cree que podría tratarse de un homicidio orquestado como parte de un plan diabólico.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Después de vislumbrar su futuro, un ambicioso político se enfrenta a un grupo de hombres misteriosos que intentan separarlo de la mujer que ama.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: Adelaida y su esposo viajan a la casa en la que ella creció junto a la playa. Tiene un presentimiento siniestro que precede a un encuentro espeluznante: cuatro enmascarados se presentan ante su casa. Lo aterrador viene cuando muestran sus rostros.

programme.title: The Nun
programme.desc: Una monja se suicida en una abadía rumana y el Vaticano envía a un sacerdote y una novicia a investigar lo sucedido. Lo que ambos encuentran allá es un secreto perverso que los enfrentará cara a cara con el mal en su esencia más pura.

programme.title: The Nun II
programme.desc: Francia, 1956. El asesinato de un sacerdote provoca que un mal demoníaco se extienda sin control. La hermana Irene deberá enfrentarse, de nuevo, a la monja satánica Valak.

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: En una carretera desierta, en plena noche, Shula se topa con el cuerpo de su tío. Durante el funeral, los primos desvelan los secretos enterrados de su familia zambiana en un vibrante análisis de las mentiras que nos decimos a nosotros mismos.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: Un amable profesor universitario descubre a un actor que se parece mucho a él y se adentra en los temas privados del hombre.

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: Cuando encuentra a la tercera víctima de un asesino en serie que no deja ninguna pista, el agente del FBI Joe Merriweather decide pedir ayuda a su amigo, el doctor Clancy, cuyas visiones pueden ayudarlo a resolver el caso.

programme.title: The Rover
programme.desc: Después de que unos ladrones se roban su carro, un hombre solitario obliga a un miembro herido de su grupo a que lo ayude a perseguirlos a través de una zona peligrosa.

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: El apocalipsis en la Tierra obliga a transportar a centenares de personas a Marte. Una de las naves espaciales pierde la ruta y los pasajeros tratan de convivir entre la angustia, aferrados a la idea de que algún día llegarán a la colonia marciana.

programme.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
programme.desc: Harley Quinn y otras tres heroínas, Canario Negro, Cazadora y Renée Montoya, unen sus fuerzas para salvar a una niña del malvado rey del crimen Máscara Negra.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: La búsqueda de una cura para la enfermedad de Alzheimer por parte de un científico tiene resultados inesperados: un chimpancé superinteligente, lo que podría provocar el fin del dominio de los humanos sobre la Tierra.

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Los simios dominan el planeta, pero una colonia de humanos ha sobrevivido al virus. César, el líder de los primates, debe elegir entre tratar de cooperar con los humanos o intentar exterminarlos.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: César y sus simios son obligados a enfrentar un conflicto mortal contra un ejército de humanos liderado por un brutal coronel. Después de sufrir pérdidas enormes, César pelea con sus instintos más oscuros en una búsqueda por vengar a su especie.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Muchos años después de la época de César, los simios se han dividido en clanes y los hombres se han vuelto salvajes. Un clan brutal secuestra a la tribu del chimpancé Noa, pero, con la ayuda de una humana, emprende la misión de rescatarlos.

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
programme.desc: En 1859, unas familias descubren el atractivo del Viejo oeste y se establecen en territorios que van desde Wyoming hasta Kansas. Mientras tanto, un vaquero rudo pronto se ve obligado a huir con una prostituta y un niño tras matar a otro pistolero.

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: El policía Cristi viaja desde Rumanía a La Gomera para aprender el silbo gomero. En Rumanía pretende comunicarse con la mafia gracias al silbo y conseguir sacar de la cárcel a Zsolt, que sabe dónde está el bote.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: Marianne es una pintora que recibe un encargo muy especial: retratar a Héloïse, quien acaba de salir del convento y va a casarse. Este retrato de bodas tiene que realizarse sin que ella lo sepa, por lo que Marianne la investigará a diario.

programme.desc: Un investigador de lo paranormal debe salvar a una pareja de una entidad malévola que se alimenta del miedo y los tormentos de ellos sin importar a dónde huyan.

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.title: The Pacific
programme.desc: El Cuerpo de Marines intenta capturar el aeródromo de Peleliu y sufren graves bajas. Leckie es evacuado de la isla. Sledge confiesa su miedo y comienza a escribir sobre su experiencia.

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.title: The Pacific

programme.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teen-aged daughter.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a `monster-in-training' boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. even for the world's most powerful vampire.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Discovering that his most-famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: After being fired from the `Anti-Villain League', Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. Once united the siblings find themselves on a mission to take down a former child star from the 1980s, now out for revenge.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: A teen and his new stepfather find an island of secrets, strange life forms and gold after they answer a coded distress signal.

programme.title: The Golden Compass
programme.desc: In a parallel universe, young orphan Lyra Belacqua resides in Oxford under the patronage of her dashing adventurer Uncle, Lord Asriel. When Lyra comes into possession of an alethiometer, a compass that truthfully answers any question, there are people who will do anything to get hold of it, and Lyra finds herself on an epic quest to the frozen North to safeguard the future of her entire world.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Based on the Mary Norton novels about a four-inch-tall family who live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree, until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. Can Dave come to their rescue?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in New York City, and dump them. They have three days to get to him and stop the proposal.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Victoria and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Discovering that his most-famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: After being fired from the `Anti-Villain League', Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. Once united the siblings find themselves on a mission to take down a former child star from the 1980s, now out for revenge.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: A teen and his new stepfather find an island of secrets, strange life forms and gold after they answer a coded distress signal.

programme.title: The Golden Compass
programme.desc: In a parallel universe, young orphan Lyra Belacqua resides in Oxford under the patronage of her dashing adventurer Uncle, Lord Asriel. When Lyra comes into possession of an alethiometer, a compass that truthfully answers any question, there are people who will do anything to get hold of it, and Lyra finds herself on an epic quest to the frozen North to safeguard the future of her entire world.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Based on the Mary Norton novels about a four-inch-tall family who live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree, until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. Can Dave come to their rescue?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in New York City, and dump them. They have three days to get to him and stop the proposal.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Victoria and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: A US Marine observes the effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow Marines from their brutal basic training to the bloody street fighting in Hue, Vietnam.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programme.title: The African Queen
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the `African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Potrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.desc: The crew of the Starship Enterprise returns home after an act of terrorism within its own organization destroys most of Starfleet. With a personal score to settle, Capt. James T. Kirk leads a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy about three New York parapsychology professors who decide to set up a ghost-catching agency. Soon a storm of malevolent spirits threatens to destroy the city, and the mysterious contents of a woman's fridge suggest a paranormal Armageddon.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The phantom-fighters return to the streets of New York when they come to the aid of a woman who fears that her baby is the target of ghostly forces. Four years after Dr Peter Venkman broke up with Dana Barrett, she appeals for help to save her son when an arch-demon trapped in an oil painting wants to take over his body. The old team reunite and trace the source of the trouble to a sinister underground river of slime.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: The secretive Men in Black are agents charged with regulating the aliens who have settled on Earth and ensure that they remain undetected. New recruit J and his partner K must find and stop an intergalactic terrorist bent on assassinating two ambassadors from opposing galaxies before they can make peace.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sequel to the sci-fi comedy about a top secret government task force set up to deal with unruly extraterrestrials. An MIB agent turns to the only man who can help him save the world from a rampaging, shape-shifting alien which has taken on the outward appearance of a sexy lingerie model.

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Agent J goes back to the swinging 60s in a time-travelling mission to save his partner from a murderous alien.

With only fear keeping the `big wuss' Columbus alive, Tallahassee wants to eradicate the `last Twinkie on Earth'. The duo join forces with Wichita and Little Rock who have a style and tact of their own when it comes to dealing with the flesh-eating chaos.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.

programme.title: Green Lantern

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: A mild mannered, socially weird government accountant moonlights as a highly trained, and deadly assassin.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Life never becomes easy for ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, who is forced out of hiding, and must return to Europe to find out exactly what happened in his past. It's not easy, as he's being framed for murder and his old employers are leading the manhunt.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Former CIA assassin Jason Bourne continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a `Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, Bourne spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Enhanced CIA assassin Aaron Cross faces a battle to survive when his CIA employers decide to do away with his programme.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Living off the grid for 10 years, former CIA operative Jason Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilises terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.title: Jaws III
programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: As rioting and civil unrest rocks Detroit during the summer of 1967, several policemen begin interrogating guests at the Algiers Motel. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.
